snippet.title: .DETUNED | Gameplay Footage | HD
snippet.description:
Hopefully this will save you money.  What's in the footage is basically all there is to do in the game.

Of course, if you're a Trophy whore, you may want to spare the $2.99/£1.99 and grab yourself 10 easy Trophies (4 Bronze, 5 Silver and 1 Gold) that took literally less than 5 minutes to unlock.

*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~ *~*~*
